import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] Comb = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] A = new long[32][32];
    static long[][] B = new long[32][32];
    static long TT;
    static int R, C, n;
    static char[] p = new char[110];
    static long[][] CC = new long[32][32];
    static long MM;
    static List<List<Pair>> P = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<Pair>> Q = new ArrayList<>();
    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long first;
        long second;
        public Pair(long first, long second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            return Long.compare(this.first, o.first);
        }
    }
    static void Put(int x, int y, long g, long c1, long c2, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            P.get(x).get(ck).add(new Pair(g, c1));
            if (c2 > 0) Q.get(x).get(ck).add(new Pair(g, c2));
            return;
        }
        Put(x + 1, y, g + (ck == 0 ? A[x + 1][y] : 0), c1, (p[x + y] != 'B' ? c2 : 0), ck);
        Put(x, y + 1, g + (ck == 1 ? B[x][y + 1] : 0), c1, (p[x + y] != 'A' ? c2 : 0), ck);
    }
    static void Calc1(int x, int y, long g, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            if (P.get(x).get(ck).isEmpty()) return;
            int t = Collections.binarySearch(P.get(x).get(ck), new Pair((TT + 1) / 2 - g, 0));
            if (t >= 0 && P.get(x).get(ck).get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (P.get(x).get(ck).get(t).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
            }
            if (t > 0 && P.get(x).get(ck).get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (P.get(x).get(ck).get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
            }
            return;
        }
        Calc1(x - 1, y, g + (ck == 0 ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
        Calc1(x, y - 1, g + (ck == 1 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
    }
    static long Res;
    static void Calc2(int x, int y, long g, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            int t = Collections.binarySearch(Q.get(x).get(ck), new Pair((TT + 1) / 2 - g, 0));
            if (t >= 0 && Q.get(x).get(ck).get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (Q.get(x).get(ck).get(t).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM == tp) Res += Q.get(x).get(ck).get(t).second;
            }
            if (t > 0 && Q.get(x).get(ck).get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (Q.get(x).get(ck).get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM == tp) Res += Q.get(x).get(ck).get(t - 1).second;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (p[x + y - 1] != 'B') Calc2(x - 1, y, g + (ck == 0 ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
        if (p[x + y - 1] != 'A') Calc2(x, y - 1, g + (ck == 1 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
    }
    static void Make(List<Pair> P) {
        if (P.isEmpty()) return;
        Collections.sort(P);
        int i, cnt = 0;
        long s = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < P.size(); i++) {
            s += P.get(i).second;
            if (i == P.size() - 1 || P.get(i).first != P.get(i + 1).first) {
                P.set(cnt++, new Pair(P.get(i).first, s));
                s = 0;
            }
        }
        P.subList(cnt, P.size()).clear();
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
            Comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) Comb[i][j] = Comb[i - 1][j - 1] + Comb[i - 1][j];
        }
        n = R + C;
        TT = Comb[n * 2][R * 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (i > 0) A[i][j] = Comb[i - 1][R - 1] * (Comb[n * 2 - i][R] - Comb[j][R]);
                if (j > 0) B[i][j] = Comb[j - 1][R - 1] * (Comb[n * 2 - j][R] - Comb[i][R]);
            }
        }
        CC[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (i != n && p[i + j] != 'B') CC[i + 1][j] += CC[i][j];
                if (j != n && p[i + j] != 'A') CC[i][j + 1] += CC[i][j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = R; i <= n; i++) {
            if (p[i + R - 1] != 'B') Put(R, i, A[R][i], Comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[R - 1][i], 0);
            if (p[i + R - 1] != 'A') Put(i, R, B[i][R], Comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[i][R - 1], 1);
        }
        for (int i = R; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                Make(P.get(i).get(j));
                Make(Q.get(i).get(j));
            }
        }
        MM = TT + 1;
        Calc1(n, n, 0, 0);
        Calc1(n, n, 0, 1);
        Calc2(n, n, 0, 0);
        Calc2(n, n, 0, 1);
        System.out.println(Res);
    }
}
